mapper.sql: WITH facts AS(SELECT i.question_id,coalesce(i.self_assessment,i.outcome) judgment,s.submitted_at,s.id session_id,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY i.question_id ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC,s.id DESC) rn FROM practice_item i JOIN practice_session s ON s.id=i.session_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.status='SUBMITTED' AND (i.outcome IN ('CORRECT','WRONG') OR i.self_assessment IS NOT NULL)),totals AS(SELECT question_id,count(*) FILTER(WHERE judgment='CORRECT') right_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE judgment='WRONG') wrong_count FROM facts GROUP BY question_id)

FROM facts f JOIN totals t ON t.question_id=f.question_id JOIN question q ON q.id=f.question_id JOIN question_revision r ON r.id=q.current_revision_id JOIN question_bank b ON b.id=q.bank_id JOIN subject s ON s.id=b.subject_id WHERE f.rn=1 AND t.wrong_count>0AND f.judgment='WRONG'AND f.judgment='CORRECT'AND q.bank_id=#{bankId}
